Al-Ahlia Company for Medical Supplies
, founded in Jordan in 1987, operates as a prominent distributor and supplier of medical devices, surgical instruments, and healthcare products, representing
multiple international manufacturer partners
alongside its proprietary line.
www.ahliamed.com
Proprietary Brand
Medicare
(China) – House brand for general medical supplies and accessories.
International Manufacturer Partners & Brands
Honda Electronics Co., Ltd.
(Japan) – Ultrasound and medical electronic systems.
Echo Control Medical - ECM
(France) – Ultrasound scanning equipment.
Erka
(Germany) – Blood pressure measuring devices and sphygmomanometers.
Flaem
(Italy) – Aerosol therapy systems and electro-medical devices.
Mediana
(South Korea) – Patient monitors and defibrillators.
Hubdic
(South Korea) – Digital thermometers and health monitoring devices.
Hurev
(South Korea) – Medical imaging and physical therapy equipment.
Foras Medical
(Turkey) – Respiratory and pulmonary care devices.
Firstplus
(Turkey) – Emergency and first-aid medical solutions.
Aroma Surgical Co.
(Pakistan) – Surgical and medical instruments.
www.ahliamed.com
